Method of Attack: Mixed-format IP address validation vulnerability causing indeterminate Server-Side Request Forgery (SSRF) and Remote File Inclusion (RFI)
Incorrect parsing of mixed-format (octal-decimal) IP addresses treating octets as decimal leading to IP address misinterpretation
Impacted Systems: Applications relying on Go's net library
Applications relying on Rust's net library
Attack Vector: Exploitation of mixed-format IP address parsing in standard libraries leading to SSRF and RFI vulnerabilities
Indicators of Compromise: Example IP addresses: 0127.0.0.1 (ambiguous leading zero IP), 0150.0024.0073.0321 (octal format), 87.0.0.1 (decimal equivalent after parsing)
